raw_segments.text: Titania, out of this would do not desire to go.
Thou shalt remain here whether thou wilt or no, I am a spirit of no common rate.
The summer still doth tend upon my state, and I do love thee, therefore go with me.
I'll give thee fairies to attend on thee, and they shall fetch thee jewels from the deep
and sing while thou on pressed flowers dost sleep, and I will purge thy mortal grossness
so that thou shalt like an airy spirit go.
Peace blossom, cobweb, moth, and mustard seed.
